Working at Hope Enterprise’s University College
Hope Enterprises or Hope is a local NGO that was established in 1971 in Addis Ababa to help the needy help themselves through basic needs, education, competence, job and business mediation and value education. As Hope was completing its 32 years of humanitarian service in 2003, it’s then Executive Director, Dr. Minas Hiruy, recommended to the Board the establishment of an outstanding liberal arts university college by submitting a full-fledged proposal. After some discussion, the Board and the General Assembly of Hope accepted the proposal, establishing Hope University College as the first public benefits institution of higher learning in the country on November 25, 2003.  Soon after, the Board adopted a new structure comprising the Ladders of Hope that subsumed the existing and non-college activities of Hope as one division and Hope University College as another division, opening the way for the university college to operate autonomously.

Assistant Registrar Head for TVET Program
About the Job
Position Title:             Assistant Registrar Head for TVET Program

Department:               Office of the Registrar

Employment Type:     Full-Time / Permanent

Job Summary

The Assistant Registrar Head for TVET Programs will be responsible for managing student academic records, supporting student registration, organizing TVET training documentation, and ensuring compliance with institutional policies and TVET regulatory standards (Level I–IV). This role involves maintaining accurate database records, issuing academic credentials, and serving as the administrative bridge between TVET trainees, trainers, and the Registrar’s Office.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

Registration & Admissions: Process intake applications, verify entry qualifications (e.g., Grade 10/12 completion certificates, COC results), and conduct registration for regular and extension TVET trainees.
Student Record Management: Maintain up-to-date physical and digital files for all TVET students, including enrollment forms, module assessments, transcript updates, and grade submissions.
Assessment & COC Documentation: Coordinate with TVET department heads to register candidates for institutional assessments and Center of Competency (COC) evaluation exams.
Academic Credentials: Prepare official transcripts, letters of attendance, completion certificates, and verification documents upon request.
Customer Support: Assist trainees with academic inquiries, course/module add/drop requests, and administrative orientation.
Reporting: Compile statistical reports on TVET trainee enrollment, retention, and completion rates for office leadership.
About You
Job Requirements & Qualifications

Education: First  Degree in information technology, information science, information systems, information system management, Computer Science, Database Administration, Statistics, Software Engineering and related fields
Experience:
Minimum of 2 years of direct experience in Curriculum tracking, managing graduation clearances, student data protection laws, processing academic transcripts, and supervising team officers (experience within a college or TVET institute is highly preferred).
Technical & Soft Skills:
Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel) and student database management software.
Knowledge of TVET modular training structures and qualification frameworks.
Strong organizational skills, high accuracy in record-keeping, and attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Document and Compliance Requirements
To satisfy official civil and institutional recruitment audits, applicants must present:
Employment Clearance: Valid, authenticated resignation letters along with formal clearance paperwork from the current or immediate past employer.
Government Authentication: the relevant state regulatory body (e.g., Education and Training Authority – ETA) must officially authenticate educational credentials.
Taxation Validation: For candidates coming from private corporations or colleges, an official income tax deduction confirmation document generated by the Ethiopian Revenues & Customs Authority (ERCA) must be supplied.

jobs.title: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator (Clinical Trial)
jobs.education: Medical Doctor (MD)
jobs.summary: Haramaya University is seeking an Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator for the EChiLiBRiST clinical trial focusing on maternal and child health studies. The role involves patient screening, clinical evaluations, and ensuring adherence to clinical trial protocols.
jobs.description: The post holder will play a crucial role in the EChiLiBRiST clinical trial, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating L-Citrulline oral supplementation to improve outcomes in admitted febrile pediatric patients at high risk of adverse outcomes. Responsibilities include screening children for eligibility, managing informed consent, conducting clinical evaluations, monitoring for adverse outcomes, collecting biological samples, and recording data accurately.
jobs.rawText:
Haramaya University Vacancy
October 6, 2026
Haramaya University Vacancy – Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator (Clinical Trial)
Organization: Haramaya University – Project
Position: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator (Clinical Trial)
Location: Haramaya and Hiwot Fana Hospitals, Harar and Haramaya, Ethiopia
Employment Type: Full-Time
Career Level: Junior Level (1–3 years)
Number of Positions: 1
Duration: 1 year, with possibility of extension
Salary: $385
Deadline: November 6, 2026

About the Job
Hararghe Health Research (HHR) is a collaborative effort between Haramaya University and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in the performance of maternal and child health studies to support programs and policy. Current research projects include Child Health and Mortality Prevention Surveillance Network (CHAMPS), Maternal Immunization (MI), Invasive Bacterial Disease (IBD), pneumococcal and meningococcal surveillance studies, and EChiLiBRiST – clinical trial.

The post holder will play a crucial role in the EChiLiBRiST clinical trial, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating L-Citrulline oral supplementation to improve outcomes in admitted febrile pediatric patients at high risk of adverse outcomes.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collecting information on the clinical management of patients, monitoring study participants, and ensuring adherence to the study protocol, Good Clinical Practice guidelines, and ethical considerations.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
Screen children for eligibility based on defined criteria.
Initiate and oversee informed consent procedures with parents/legal guardians, ensuring clear understanding of study participation.
Enroll eligible participants into the study.
Conduct thorough initial and follow-up clinical evaluations of admitted patients.
Monitor participants for adverse outcomes and readmission.
Assess and manage adverse events and serious adverse events, reporting them as required by the protocol.
Ensure appropriate standard of care is provided to all participants.
Oversee the administration of assigned study supplements to randomized participants.
Monitor tolerability and outcomes.
Oversee the collection of various biological samples at specified timepoints for laboratory assessments.
Accurately record all clinical information and study data in Case Report Forms.
Ensure data confidentiality and proper handling of patient information.
Ensure participants and caregivers adhere to study procedures and follow-up schedules while in the hospital.
Required Qualification and Experience
Education: Medical Doctor (MD).

Experience: Minimum experience required is 0 years. Experience in general practice, particularly with pediatric patients, clinical research, or clinical trials is an advantage.

Certification: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification and a medical license are mandatory.

Skills:

Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic skills in pediatrics.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact sensitively with patients and their families.
Attention to detail for accurate data collection and documentation.
Ability to work effectively within a research team.
Proficiency in English and local languages relevant to the study sites, such as Afan Oromo and Amharic.
Knowledge: Familiarity with clinical trial processes and ethical guidelines in research.

The position will primarily be based at Haramaya Hospital and Hiwot Fana Hospital in Haramaya and Harar, Ethiopia. The role involves working in the Emergency Pediatric Outpatient Department (EPOPD) and/or pediatric wards.

Ethiopian Securities Exchange Job Vacancy 2026
ESX is Ethiopia’s first, and only organized securities exchange. ESX is being established as a public private partnership in line with Article 31 of the Capital Market Proclamation (No.1248/2021).

ESX operates the business of a securities exchange, functions as a Self-Regulatory Organization (“SRO”), and serves as the central market organizer providing an integrated product suite covering the equities, fixed income, and money market segments of the capital markets.

Position: Young Professional
Educational Background:

Bachelor’s degree (completed within the last two years) in Accounting and Finance, Economics, Law,Business-related, or a closely related field.
 A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.25 is required.
For female applicants, a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 is accepted to encourage gender inclusion.
Fresh graduates with up to two years of related experience.
Analytical and Quantitative Skills:

Demonstrated strong analytical thinking, numerical proficiency, and data interpretation skills.
Language Proficiency:

Fluent in English and Amharic languages
Proficiency in other Ethiopian language(s) is considered an asset.
Additional Competencies:

Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in diverse teams.
Interest in financial markets and capital market development.

jobs.rawText:
Progress Business Group PLC Job Vacancy
Business Development & Marketing Manager Vacancy at Progress Business Group PLC.
Position: Business Development & Marketing Manager
Required Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Economics, Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or related fields.
Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in business development, consultancy, tender/proposal preparation, marketing, or professional services.
Proven experience in proposal and tender preparation is highly preferred.
Experience working with consulting firms, government tenders, NGOs, or development organizations is an advantage.
Desired Skills
Ability to understand TORs/RFPs and prepare compliant proposals.
Strong networking, negotiation, and client relationship skills.
Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.
Excellent English writing and communication skills.
Strong computer skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Strong understanding of business and economic analysis.
Job Summary
Progress Business Group PLC is looking for a motivated, experienced, and results-oriented Business Development & Marketing Manager to lead the company’s marketing, business development, client acquisition, and consultancy project development activities.

The successful candidate will promote the company’s professional services, identify new clients and business opportunities, monitor consultancy tenders, coordinate proposal preparation, and support the development of business plans, feasibility studies, and other consultancy assignments.

Key Responsibilities
1. Marketing & Business Development

Develop and implement marketing and business development strategies.
Identify and develop new business opportunities for the company.
Identify potential clients from private companies, government institutions, banks, investors, NGOs, and development organizations.
Promote the company’s asset valuation and consultancy services.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
Conduct market research and identify new market opportunities.
Prepare and implement business development and marketing plans.
Maintain a database of business opportunities and potential clients.
Arrange client meetings, presentations, and business discussions.
Follow up on leads, quotations, proposals, and potential contracts.
2. Tender & Proposal Management

Continuously monitor government, private sector, NGO, and development-partner tenders and consultancy opportunities.
Review Terms of Reference (TORs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Expressions of Interest (EOIs), and tender documents.
Assess tender opportunities and recommend suitable opportunities for participation.
Prepare and coordinate EOIs, technical proposals, and financial proposals.
Prepare proposal methodologies, work plans, company profiles, and relevant documents.
Coordinate with technical experts to collect CVs, experience records, methodologies, and technical inputs.
Prepare tender compliance checklists and submission schedules.
Ensure proposals are complete, competitive, and submitted before deadlines.
Maintain a database of previous proposals, CVs, company credentials, and project references.
Follow up on submitted proposals and maintain records of tender results.
3. Business Plan & Feasibility Study

Participate in or coordinate business plan preparation.
Conduct investment feasibility studies.
Undertake market assessments and market research.
Conduct financial and economic analysis.
Prepare investment and project proposals.
Assess business and investment opportunities.
Develop financial projections and basic financial models.
Prepare professional reports and presentations.
4. Client & Partnership Development

Establish relationships with companies, investors, financial institutions, and development partners.
Develop partnerships and consortium opportunities with other consulting firms and experts.
Represent the company in business meetings, networking events, and professional forums.
Company: Progress Business Group PLC
Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: As per company scale
Deadline: October 19, 2026
